Usage: mai [options] [command]

LinkedIn autonomous agent

Options:
  -V, --version            output the version number
  --model <spec>           LLM model spec (provider:modelId); overrides
                           FRONDOSE_MODEL (legacy MAI_MODEL still accepted)
  --prompt <text>          one-shot prompt; exits after response
  --new-session            start a fresh session (discard prior context)
                           (default: false)
  --cwd <dir>              working directory for session storage (default:
                           "/Users/kyoubelyu/frondose")
  --reset-identity         delete identity.json and re-run first-run bootstrap
                           (default: false)
  --max-steps <n>          max agent-loop tool-call steps per turn (overrides
                           FRONDOSE_MAX_STEPS [legacy MAI_MAX_STEPS still
                           accepted]; default 200)
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  soul <action>            Soul-band controls: reset re-prompts the 4 free
                           axes.
  serve [options]          HTTP-over-UDS bridge for the v0.5 Tauri desktop
                           shell
  update [options]         Check for frondose updates on GitHub Releases
  update-server [options]  Serve the local Frondose download portal + updater
                           manifest (~/.frondose/site/) over LAN HTTP
  uninstall [options]      Remove the global mai install (bin + package symlink
                           + release dirs); --purge also removes ~/.frondose/
  status                   Show agent status (auth + chrome + identity +
                           telegram + cron + memory)
  analytics                Show sales analytics: funnel, rates, score
                           calibration, auto-run history
  cron                     Cron schedule management
